stolen_light.name: Knot of Stolen Light
stolen_light.desc: A warm violet knot cut from the Lamp-Glutton's belly, pulsing like a slow breath. Every crystal she drank is in here.

painted_lantern.name: Musk-Painted Lantern
painted_lantern.desc: A small lantern, cracked and burned dry, found in the Lamp-Glutton's nest. Its glass is smeared with something sweet that moths can't leave alone. Nothing down there lit it by itself.

heartcrystal_shard.name: Heartcrystal Shard
heartcrystal_shard.desc: A sliver that fell from the Heartcrystal as it woke. It glows violet in your hand, steady as the city's lamps used to be.

glimmerdust_pendant.name: Glimmerdust Pendant
glimmerdust_pendant.desc: A pinch of Glimmerwing's wing-dust sealed in glass. It never quite goes dark.

hollow_tenders_rod.name: Hollow Tender's Rod
hollow_tenders_rod.desc: The rod a crystal-tender taps a crystal with to hear whether it's sound. This one's tender never came back up.

lampglutton_sash.name: Lamp-Glutton's Silk Sash
lampglutton_sash.desc: Cut from the cocoon she wound round the Heartcrystal. Pale, tough, and faintly warm.

deepwatch_blade.name: Deepwatch Blade
deepwatch_blade.desc: A sentinel's sword from the Duskhold armory, given by one who was told she'd never draw from it again.

deepwatch_dirk.name: Deepwatch Dirk
deepwatch_dirk.desc: A sentinel's off-hand blade from the Duskhold armory, given by one who was told she'd never draw from it again.

deepwatch_mace.name: Deepwatch Mace
deepwatch_mace.desc: A sentinel-chaplain's mace from the Duskhold armory, given by one who was told she'd never draw from it again.

deepwatch_wand.name: Deepwatch Wand
deepwatch_wand.desc: A watch-mage's wand from the Duskhold armory, tipped with a chip of glow crystal. Given by one who was told she'd never draw from it again.
